_notes: Taito do Brasil 1979 hardware (PinMAME taito_old). Compiled 2026-10 by evilwraith from the Shock ROM and three
saved images (attract, mid-game at ball 3, after the match sequence) on an AtGames ALP4K. The window is at 0x1000:
display at 0x1000, command DMA at 0x1010, settings 0x10F0-0x10F8 (same nine-byte BCD block as the later boards),
high score 0x10F9, credits 0x10FF with its display copy at 0x100F. Football is listed by PinMAME but its ROM is
lost; obaobao shares the hardware but has not been checked.

player_count._notes: 1 in all three images; the reset path refuses to resume with 5 or more.
player_count.label: Players

credits._notes: Stored value; 0x100F is its display copy and tracks it in every image.
credits.label: Credits

game_over._notes: Bit 0 of the flags byte: 1 in attract and after the match sequence, 0 mid-game. Written by both reset-validation failure paths.
game_over.label: Game Over

score._notes: Most-significant byte first; shown on the player 1 display in attract (470,000 in the attract image).
